description: This file initializes and manages a Supabase client within a frontend JavaScript/TypeScript project. It dynamically imports the '@supabase/supabase-js' library and provides an asynchronous function to retrieve a singleton client instance, handling environment variables for configuration and logging warnings if required variables are missing or dependencies are absent.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Asynchronously returns a configured Supabase client instance, initializing it if necessary, or null if environment variables are missing or dependencies are not installed.
